name: Julian Rosefeldt
bio: Julian Rosefeldt is a German artist and filmmaker. Rosefeldt's work consists primarily of elaborate, visually opulent film and video installations, often shown as panoramic multi-channel projections. His installations range in style from documentary to theatrical narrative.

credits.title: Euphoria
credits.overview: A journey through the history of capitalism and greed. Populated by surreal characters and animals, a dystopian New York serves as the backdrop for a hypnotizing trip deep into the complexity of human nature at its best and worst.

credits.title: American Night
credits.overview: Several scenes showing evening as it turns to night in an anachronistic take on the wild west. 5-channel Installation piece, also presented as a single video.
